title: Headless Grid Renderer
description: New CLI RenderGrid that renders N mesh candidates in a single labeled grid image for VLM tournament consumption. Each cell auto-framed with consistent camera angle, labeled 1-N. Extends the existing RenderDsl headless rendering pattern.
definition-of-done: 1. RenderGrid CLI accepts --inputs dir/ --output grid.png --cols N --cell-size N. 2. Renders each DSL/OBJ in the input directory to a cell. 3. Cells auto-framed with consistent camera. 4. Cells labeled 1-N. 5. Grid image suitable for VLM consumption (clear labels, consistent lighting).
testing-plan: 1. Render 4 known DSL files in a 2x2 grid. 2. Verify output PNG dimensions match cols * cell-size. 3. Render 16 files in a 4x4 grid and visually confirm labeling.
todos: Implement per-cell mesh loading and auto-framing
